title: The Hide-Mother: a real final boss
changes: Grandam Ursk, the Hide-Mother, is now a proper final boss at the bottom of the Mawdeep, level 30.
She talks: she has her say as she wakes, taunts you through the fight, gloats when a hero falls, and has last words.
Phase 1, the Mother: claws and roars.
Phase 2, the Rite (below 70%): she calls her brood, throws a hooked gut line that drags far-off heroes to her, and sews her living children back into her hide to heal. Kill them first!
Phase 3, the Bear (below 35%): she tears off what is left of the woman, grows bigger, gets faster and brings the roof down.
